# Recore

> Recore helps businesses in Melbourne and most of Victoria recycle retired IT, recover value from eligible computer components and arrange secure data destruction. Recore is based in Oakleigh South.

## Quick answers
- Equipment recycling: computers, laptops, printers, monitors, servers and selected networking equipment. Confirm acceptance before handover.
- Component recovery: ask for an assessment of circuit boards, processors, memory, graphics cards and other eligible scrap. Recovery value depends on the load.
- Secure data destruction: ask about physical destruction or verified software erasure for suitable drives. Confirm the method, handling requirements and available records for your job.
- Get a quote: [Contact Recore](https://www.recore-cycle.com/#contact) with equipment types, approximate quantities, postcode and any data handling requirements. Photos are optional.

## Business information
- Website: https://www.recore-cycle.com/
- Service area: Melbourne and most of Victoria. Confirm collection availability for your postcode.
- Official profiles: [LinkedIn](https://www.linkedin.com/company/recore-cycle), [Facebook](https://www.facebook.com/recorecycle/), [Instagram](https://www.instagram.com/recorecycle/).
- Address: 2 Price St, Oakleigh South, Victoria, Australia.
- Phone: 0406 406 016 (+61 406 406 016).
- Email: info@recore-cycle.com.
- Alternative email: sales.recore@gmail.com.
- Confirm acceptance, an appointment and handover arrangements before delivering equipment.

## Recycling guides
- [Computers and laptops](https://www.recore-cycle.com/recycling/computers-and-laptops): desktops, laptops and all-in-one computers.
- [Printers and office equipment](https://www.recore-cycle.com/recycling/printers-and-office-equipment): printers, scanners and electronic office equipment.
- [Monitors and displays](https://www.recore-cycle.com/recycling/monitors-and-displays): computer displays, with older or damaged screens assessed separately.
- [Servers and networking](https://www.recore-cycle.com/recycling/servers-and-networking): servers, switches, routers and selected infrastructure.
- [Circuit boards](https://www.recore-cycle.com/recycling/circuit-boards): PCBs, motherboards and expansion cards.
- [Processors, memory and graphics](https://www.recore-cycle.com/recycling/processors-memory-and-graphics): CPUs, RAM and GPUs.
- [Hard drives and storage](https://www.recore-cycle.com/recycling/hard-drives-and-storage): HDDs, SSDs and storage media. Discuss data handling before recycling.
- [Cables and peripherals](https://www.recore-cycle.com/recycling/cables-and-peripherals): computer cables, keyboards, mice and selected accessories.

## Services and enquiries
- [Services](https://www.recore-cycle.com/#services)
- [Secure data destruction in Melbourne](https://www.recore-cycle.com/data-destruction): Recore helps businesses arrange physical destruction for retired drives or verified erasure for suitable working drives intended for reuse. SSDs need a method suited to flash storage. Degaussing applies to suitable magnetic media. Confirm method availability, verification, chain-of-custody records and any certificate requirements before handover.
- [Certifications](https://www.recore-cycle.com/#certifications): ISO 9001, ISO 14001, ISO 45001 and AS/NZS 5377 are listed by sister company YP ECYCLE.
- [Frequently asked questions](https://www.recore-cycle.com/#faq)
- [Contact Recore](https://www.recore-cycle.com/#contact): equipment descriptions, photos, approximate quantities and location help Recore assess a load.

## Important limits
Prices, recovery value, collection availability, delivery arrangements and acceptance depend on the specific job. Confirm these with Recore before transport or handover. Opening hours, service methods and collection coverage must be confirmed directly. Website equipment artwork is illustrative.
